title: Draw the subgroup and homogeneous-space diagram
as_he_states: Il faudrait faire un diagramme: inclusion relations or the corresponding morphisms between homogeneous spaces.
plausible_today: The30 actual subgroups form a poset with66 cover inclusions; S4/H morphisms additionally depend on transporter cosets, not merely subgroup conjugacy classes.
state_of_art: The subgroup-poset part is completed in s4_subgroups.json and s4_hasse_edges.json. For transitive sets, Hom_G(G/H,G/K)={gK:g^-1Hg⊂K}; proof supplement §1 supplies the subgroup data and this standard formula gives all morphisms.
why_open: The packet contains the request but no drawn completion. No source explains why it was not drawn.
worth: Moderate expository value; one short run could render both poset and transporter category from the saved exact data.

title: Prove uniqueness of extending octahedral symmetries
as_he_states: The small argument on scan51 is requested to justify extension and uniqueness; scans48–53 also assert the full bare six-point stabilizer equals the direct octahedral group.
plausible_today: With2 invertible, retain the regular opposition and obtain rank24. If opposition is forgotten, also invert5. In characteristic5 the bare stabilizer has120 geometric elements and five regular oppositions.
state_of_art: The structured relative proof and counterexample are in proof supplement §6 and cube_and_pgl.json. Hua2026 §42 Thm42.1/Counterexample42.2 settles the field fixer calculation but explicitly leaves the relative theorem unproved; Beauville2010 gives a field normalizer under its prime-to-characteristic convention.

worth: High value; a short run can turn the relative correction into a concise, checked commentary theorem.

state_of_art: The literal statement is refuted by the C2² example with every hypothesis checked (C-SA16-291, supplement §9, saved code/output). SGA1 XIII§2 gives tame framework; Stacks03PK gives the cyclic root groupoid. The quadratic special case is validated by AntieauMeierDef4.4/Prop4.5.

worth: Highest mathematical value; a short run should first formulate exact categories and test full faithfulness before claiming a repaired theorem.
